title: From Dusk Till Dawn
description: Dione at night: map 16011, EU_IcelandNight_4096 / IceLandNight_01. Same landscape as 16010, night lighting, client time table allows hour 0 only. The local profile (spawn grid, zone, doors, breakables, heightmap) is the shared IceLand one.

map.note: Map 16011 = EU_IcelandNight_4096 / IceLandNight_01. The client time table allows hour 0 only (night). The other launcher calls this map broken because the stock server has no support for the night event mode; the local room drives the scene itself.
